name: Florida Youth Institute
org: University of Florida, Center for Precollegiate Education and Training
what_you_do: A 1 week stay on campus. You study life science, biology engineering, natural resources and Florida farms. You may qualify for a UF scholarship. It is worth $7,500.
who_can_apply: Rising 11th and 12th graders anywhere in the US (a few spots for out of state students). For motivated students who like farming and related sciences.
pay_detail: $800 program cost plus $25 application fee; need based scholarships
duration: 1 week residential (June 28 to July 3 or July 5 to 10 in 2026)
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due Feb 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the CPET online application portal. Students must write a 1500 to 2000 word World Food Prize essay, due April 15, 2026 for invited students, per the page. Application fee is non-refundable.
notes: Students can compete for the World Food Prize and become Borlaug Scholars, per the page.
